name: web-orlina-case-study-intro-ux-challenge-with-flowing-silk
title: Orlina case study intro: moody portrait, chapter index and 'UX Challenge' over flowing black silk
whatItIs: A tall dark page opening with a softly lit woman in a grey blazer, an italic serif chapter index (UX Challenge, Goals, Information Architecture, User Flow…), then big bronze 'UX' and italic 'Challenge' with a large '01' over a 3D ribbon of black satin, followed by a text block and '02 UX Goals'.
whatItMeans: Luxurious and cinematic; flowing fabric separates chapters like a fashion film.
techniques: Use a flowing 3D fabric as each chapter divider.
Number chapters with large thin numerals.
Mix a bold sans with an italic serif in headings.

vocabulary.definition: A visual break introducing a new section.
